status: DRAFT - frozen before any EDGE04 H3 result is consumed
purpose: Bind the already-running execution-grade EDGE04 H3 exp_trend evaluation to a later isolated C-F02 PAPER decision without launching a duplicate backtest or tuning on its result.

candidate.signal: EMA20 crosses above EMA50, close>EMA200, ret42>0 and ret180>0
candidate.exit: EMA20<EMA50 or either momentum return is non-positive
candidate.signal_identity: The signed family contract proves C-F02 has the same long entry signal set as C-F01; only management differs.
candidate.development_context_warning: Legacy flat funding/filter assumptions; never promotion evidence and never used to change the frozen gates below.

edge04_binding.h3_signal: EMA20 crosses above EMA50, close>EMA200, ret42>0 and ret180>0; exit EMA20<EMA50 or either momentum return is non-positive
edge04_binding.runtime_parity: The runtime C-F02 exp_trend signal and exit set must remain identical to this H3 definition; source drift before a cohort is INCONCLUSIVE.
edge04_binding.rule: Consume only the final signed, immutable H3 primary result produced by the accepted EDGE04 execution-grade path. A draft, partial, failed, superseded or unsigned output is INCONCLUSIVE and cannot authorize PAPER.
edge04_binding.no_duplicate: EDGE04 H3 is the execution-grade C-F02 evaluation already in progress; this ticket must not launch another market-data run.

frozen_gates.data: every headline symbol/split complete; no account bust; no unresolved accounting row
frozen_gates.activity: at least 60 closed episodes and at least 0.75 closed episodes per week across development+walk-forward
frozen_gates.walk_forward: at least 4 of 5 folds have positive net R; combined walk-forward mean net R>0 and PF>1.10
frozen_gates.expectancy: episode-clustered 95% lower confidence bound of combined walk-forward mean net R>0; pre-cost gross mean R>0
frozen_gates.baselines: base net return exceeds B1 and the episode-clustered 95% lower bound of candidate-minus-B0 mean R is >0
frozen_gates.stress: all-variable-costs x1.5 mean net R>0; no sign flip at 60-second latency; fees/slippage x2 reported
frozen_gates.concentration: no symbol exceeds 35% of absolute net-R contribution and top three do not exceed 60%
frozen_gates.drawdown: base max equity drawdown<25%, closed-trade max drawdown<25R, and all-variable-costs x1.5 max equity drawdown<35%
frozen_gates.multiplicity: Holm alpha 0.05 across the four primaries; report deflated/search-aware statistics with 75 prior+new strategy looks
frozen_gates.verdict: PASS only if every gate passes for the frozen primary; diagnostics cannot rescue it
frozen_gates.additional_no_rescue: Development packets and PAPER cannot rescue a failed H3 primary.

decision.eligible_for_paper: EDGE04 H3 final status PASS, every frozen gate true, signed immutable output and independent reproduction of the result envelope.
decision.park: Any frozen gate false gives REJECT/PARK with no tuning on the evaluated windows; advance the next preregistered candidate.
decision.inconclusive: Incomplete data/costs/B0, unsigned or moving head, missing independent evidence, or a changed gate/result schema.
decision.inconclusive_rerun: An INCONCLUSIVE H3 may be re-run only under a new signed amendment that preserves the append-only trial history; never silently restart or take a second look.
decision.high_drawdown: Drawdown is permitted only inside the frozen numeric gates; profitability never waives a failed protection, accounting, data or multiplicity gate.

paper_pack.isolation: C-F02 runs alone in the trend_long candidate family; C-F01 must be OFF for the full cohort.
paper_pack.default: OFF until a separate Codex PAPER authorization on an accepted installed build.
paper_pack.entry_and_cost_parity: Use the accepted runtime signal, next-executable-open convention, measured fees/funding/slippage, exchange filters and candidate accounting; any parity gap is fail-closed.
paper_pack.risk: Reuse the signed candidate share/family cap/protection contract; no result-derived risk increase.
paper_pack.minimum_observation: Preregister exact duration/close count and parity fields in the cohort pack before enable; PAPER is confirmation/operations evidence, not a failed-backtest rescue.
paper_pack.rollback: Disable only C-F02, preserve and manage open lots, archive immutable evidence, and never fall back silently to C-F01.
paper_pack.protection: Every admitted lot needs confirmed Binance testnet protection; any unknown environment or protection gap refuses new risk.

deferred: reading or interpreting the active EDGE04 H3 result
changing EDGE04, strategy, management, cost, window, gate or trial definitions
implementing or enabling a C-F02 activation route
roadmap_fit: Continuous Strategy Factory conveyor: prepare the evidence-to-PAPER binding while EDGE04 H3/B0 runs; only dependent promotion waits.
